comparison.objective: Secure a gas cylinder in its cradle before removing the valve cap; not adjust a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Strap/bar closure and cap removal in a safety-critical order rather than key insertion, collar tuning, and torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Strap across cradle before cap removal; cylinder upright, cap placed in tray. Strap-force and upright tolerances are unstated. Candidate evaluates dynamic stopping and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Safety ordering and restraint differ materially from calibration through mechanical adjustment.
